data.long_meaning: The name Flowers is derived from the Greek word 'anthos', meaning 'flower'. This name symbolizes the beauty and grace of God's creation. In Christianity, flowers often represent the resurrection of Jesus, as well as new beginnings and spiritual growth. The name Flowers carries the meaning “Blossoms of God's Creation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Flowers usually hope their child will grow to embody blossoms of god's creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
